description: This file defines the EmployeeLicenseAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing employee licenses within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting employee license records, along with validation rules and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseAPI
classes.description: REST API class for managing employee licenses, including CRUD operations and validation rules, with integrated OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee license by employee number and license ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all licenses of a specific employee, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new employee license record.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee license record.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more employee licenses based on provided IDs.

methods.name: saveEmployeeLicense
methods.description: Helper method to create or update an EmployeeLicense entity from request parameters.
